facts.text: Huston-Tillotson University is the first institution of higher education in Austin, Texas, tracing its roots back to 1875 as a historically Black liberal arts university.

sources.quote: HT is an independent, church-related, historically black, four-year liberal arts institution located on a 23-acre tree-lined campus near downtown in East Austin.
